column3: Private home prices rose 1.4% in 3Q 2026, and more than 32,000 new units could go on sale within two years. Read it before you buy or sell a home.
For individual-owned private-hire car purchases signed from 30 Oct 2026, financing is capped at 60% or 70% of the price and seven years. Check the applicable limit before buying.
Employment grew by 27,700 in 3Q 2026, but retrenchments edged up in outward-oriented sectors. Check your own sector in the release before a job move.
From 1 Dec 2026, eligible patients can receive subsidised hereditary breast and ovarian cancer genetic testing. Ask your doctor to assess your risk and eligibility for referral.
Real median income grew 1.3% a year in 2019 to 2025, down from 3.4% in 2015 to 2019. Manufacturing output grew 5.0% a year while its resident jobs fell 1.3% a year.
MOH does not require a medical practitioner to sign off on an insurer's medical-necessity refusal. Policyholders can take disputes over claims or pre-authorisation to FIDReC.
IMDA is studying how AI changes entry-level tech hiring. Students in tech courses can look at Bridge2Tech for work experience.

For Year of Assessment 2026, owners of two, three to four, and five or more residential properties declared net rental income of $1.7b, $0.9b and $0.4b respectively. The last figure may include some non-residential rent.
Singapore has no plans to join the OECD scheme that shares property ownership data between tax authorities.
The next $300 in CDC Vouchers is due in January 2027; Assurance Package cash is due in December 2026 for eligible Singaporeans. Check whether your June 2026 vouchers remain unspent.
The haze subsidy scheme ceased from 12 Nov 2026; the $10 cap for eligible patients no longer applies under that scheme.
This consultation closed on 9 Nov 2026. It covers energy labels and minimum standards for washing machines, fans and dishwashers.

If your transport spending is high, compare it with a monthly pass. The Public Transport Council and SimplyGo plan to notify commuters who may benefit based on past travel.

Eligible Singaporeans aged 21 or older in 2027 receive $100 to $250 from 8 Dec 2026. Check govbenefits.gov.sg; link PayNow-NRIC by 24 Nov for earlier payment.
For your Singapore checkpoint travel history, request it through ICA's website feedback channel. MHA says there is no current plan for MyICA self-service.
Households must apply for a Public Transport Voucher the first time so eligibility can be checked. Eligible households that received vouchers before may be paid automatically.
If you cannot pay your tax, apply to IRAS for a longer instalment plan beyond the standard 12-month interest-free GIRO plan.
If you received Workfare in the past year, check your eligibility for the Workfare Transport Concession Card. PTC is reviewing automatic applications; it has not announced implementation.
For substantial short-term care needs, check whether subsidised Home Personal Care or the Interim Caregiver Service applies to your situation.
From 2 Nov 2026, Police outgoing calls use 6000 0999, followed by a gov.sg SMS; the number cannot receive calls. Verify suspicious callers with Police through official channels.
Public accountants can apply via Bizfile from 1 Dec for 2027 registration and choose a one-, two- or three-year renewal. The renewal period ends on 31 Dec 2026.
